info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Parking Reservations Checkin-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Check-in API facilitates the efficient management of parking check-ins for multiple reservations. This endpoint allows users to confirm and process check-ins for reserved parking spaces, streamlining the arrival process for guests. Ideal for parking operators and reservation systems, it enhances the user experience by ensuring that all necessary data is collected and processed in a single request. By providing a simple interface for batch operations, this API is designed to meet the needs of developers integrating check-in functionalities into their applications.

post.summary: Process a check-in for a reservation.
post.description: This endpoint allows for processing the check-in of a customer for a specific reservation. It validates the reservation details and updates the status accordingly.
